messages:
Jamie: quick oncall handoff — heading offsite, leaving coverage notes. TL;DR: deployed model-pack v3.2.1 canary (passed), autoscaler policy tweak in pool-A, and a prefix-cache miss pattern for tenant 'acme' to watch.

Jamie: changes since last handoff:
- 02:10 UTC: rolled model-pack v3.2.1 to prod (canary -> 10%) — no obvious quality regressions but keep an eye on generation_score.
- Autoscaler: PR #4123 merged (scale_down_delay changed 120s -> 30s) for dedicated-pool-A to reduce idle cost. This increases risk of short-term flapping if we get bursty traffic.
- Observed ~0.5% uptick in p95 latency for text-gen on g4dn-s instances between 04:00-06:00 UTC yesterday. Root cause traced to metrics-sidecar causing CPU spikes; patch merged to sidecar (staged).
- infra-db maintenance planned 2026-04-01 01:00-02:00 UTC (console read-only).
- model-sync worker rollout scheduled 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC (low risk).

Jamie: what to watch:
- prefix-cache miss spike for tenant 'acme' (metrics: /metrics?series=prefix_cache_miss&tenant=acme). Misses -> higher token cost and latency. Seen intermittent spikes at ~30m intervals.
- devex-api-errors alert is at 85% of burn rate (alert channel: #alerts). If it crosses 90% we may need to pause noncritical ingest jobs.
- scale events on pool-A: if >3 scale-down/up events in 15m, this could indicate flapping.

Jamie: action items / owners:
- @Sanjay: watch pool-A autoscaler for first 2 hours; check scale event rate and confirm telemetry is capturing reasons (`/infra/telemetry/scales?pool=pool-A`). Ping me if you see >3 events/15m or increased error rates.
- @Lucy: monitor generation_score from evals-ensemble for v3.2.1; if score drops >2% relative to baseline revert canary and notify #model-ops.
- @Marco: run manual prefix warming for 'acme' if misses spike: `scripts/warm_prefix.sh acme --concurrency 8` and post the logs to this thread.
- @opsbot: post a summary of any firing alerts to #eng-oncall every 15m for the next 2 hours.

Jamie: quick runbook links and commands:
- scale events dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/pool-a/scales (open read-only)
- prefix cache dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/prefixes/cache-miss
- check recent scale events via CLI: `rwd infra scales list --pool pool-A --since 15m`

Jamie: handoff plan: @Sanjay covers 1st 2h, @Lucy covers next 4h, then normal schedule. I'm reachable on pager and phone if needed. Leaving at 09:20 UTC. :wave:

Sanjay: acked. I'll be on for the first window. Quick Q — is the sidecar patch deployed everywhere or only to canary?

Jamie: sidecar patch is staged to canary and to 20% of infra nodes. Full rollout scheduled after we validate no regressions in the next 6h.

Lucy: taking next window. I'll wire up a short eval run every 30m for v3.2.1 and post results here. If I see >1% drift in generation_score across three consecutive runs I'll pull canary.

Marco: on warming — will run the warm_prefix script now and paste logs here. ETA 10m.

opsbot: ALERT SUMMARY: devex-api-errors at 85% burn, prefix_cache_miss (acme) spike: 4x baseline in last 20m, no pager escalation yet.

Sanjay: noted. If opsbot repeats spike I'll increase autoscaler slack to +10% for pool-A (temporary) to avoid flapping. Will report back in 20m.

Marco: logs pasted: `[2026-04-01T09:12:45Z] warm_prefix.sh started for acme; concurrency=8; warmed 120 prefixes in 45s; post-warm miss rate dropped 65%`. Attaching snippet: ```shell
$ ./scripts/warm_prefix.sh acme --concurrency 8
WARMED=120 success=120 errors=0 time_s=45
```

Lucy: saw Marco's results — good improvement. I'll keep the eval cadence and report any generation_score drift.

Jamie: thanks all. Leaving handoff in good shape. If anything escalates, follow the runbooks linked above and @mention me. :thumbsup:
